query: Show me the 10 most recent emails in my inbox and then read message 3.
expected_behavior: use `himalaya envelope list` (default account, default `inbox` mailbox alias) optionally with `--page-size 10`
then `himalaya message read 3` for the message
do NOT use the removed v1 `--folder` flag — mailbox selection is `-m/--mailbox` in v2
do NOT claim `-a` must come after the subcommand — it is a global option in v2 and works in either position
notes: Confirms the basic list→read flow is findable from SKILL.md without entering reference/. Guards against reintroducing the v1 `--folder` flag or the obsolete `-a`-placement rule.
